verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents Gateway just-in-time funding, where your system receives each funding request at transaction time and approves or denies it using your own business rules. That covers the JIT half of the story. The pack contains no evidence of a prefunded-balance funding option and no documentation comparing the cash-flow tradeoffs between the two models. Missing for 10: documented prefunded-balance funding model, a way to choose between funding models, documented cash-flow tradeoffs, independent corroboration.
